description: See which sidebar threads run on a schedule: a small clock marks every thread an enabled automation works in. An automation that always runs in one thread marks that thread; one that starts a new thread per run marks its latest run. The clock takes the empty status slot, or sits left of a spinner, unread dot or draft in the spinner's muted tone. Hovering a row hides it, so the row's usual actions show. Requires the built-in Automations plugin; paused automations get no clock.
